g.text: One VPC 10.0.0.0/16. Two AZs. NAT in each AZ.
Dev, QA, and UAT each have an EKS cluster.
They share one Aurora writer and reader.
NACL on public, private, and database subnets.
A lost AZ is tolerated. A lost region is not.
HPA to 6 pods. Cluster autoscaler adds nodes.
Prod account ********6823
Pre-prod VPC 10.4.0.0/16. Prod VPC 10.5.0.0/16.
Each has its own cluster and Global Database.
Primary in us-east-1, reader in us-west-1.
Same NACL pattern and the same pod spread.
Compute in us-west-1 is built only at failover.
Management ********5105 holds Route 53 only.
What keeps a request alive
Pods: 2 replicas, spread across zones, PodDisruptionBudget minAvailable 1, HPA at 70% CPU.
Nodes: two private subnets, cluster autoscaler, encrypted gp3 disks.
Data: Aurora promotes the reader. RDS Proxy pools connections. Redis and Amazon MQ are Multi-AZ.
Edge: CloudFront and two WAF policies. S3 is private. Security groups plus subnet NACLs.
ECR: one repository per service in non-prod, replicated into the prod account.
